build_dataframe_from_interchange: build a Polars DataFrame from any object supporting the dataframe interchange protocol with __dataframe__ method
construct_data_buffer: construct a data buffer from a Buffer object, dtype, and length with optional offset and allow_copy flag
construct_offsets_buffer: construct an Int64 offsets buffer from a Buffer object for string columns with zero-copy validation
construct_validity_buffer: construct a validity buffer from bitmask, bytemask, NaN, or sentinel null representation strategies
convert_string_column: convert a string column from the interchange protocol to a Polars Series with offsets and validity buffers
